NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author posted a before/after dark-mode screenshot in a comment. There was no new push, and the PR description is unchanged.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Screenshot ask: a before/after image is now posted (in a comment, not in the description). |
| ❌  | No "Fixes: #N" and no linked issue. Open issue #38931 ("Emoji and global time popover arrows should match background") looks like the match, but its "help wanted" status isn't in the input. |
| ❌  | The Testing section never says the change was checked in a browser in dark mode. It only describes the CSS. |
| ⚠️  | The extra `data-placement="right"` arrow rule isn't covered by the screenshot or explained as part of this fix. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to link the issue (confirming it has "help wanted"), describe their manual testing, and move the screenshot into the description.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the screenshot! To move this forward, please add "Fixes: #N" for the issue this addresses (is it #38931?), and say how you tested it in dark mode, including the new `right` placement rule. It would also help to move the screenshot into the PR description, per the [guide on submitting a pull request](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html).
```
